The 6 Munger Reject Gates (v6.30)

"Tell me where I am going to die so that I never go there." Every qualitative step is a sequential REJECT gate: a company leaves the funnel at the first gate it fails. Only companies clearing all 6 gates enter the Quantitative valuation sheet.

Gate 1: Simple to Understand

Favours established, transparent business models with long verifiable track records. Rejects opaque structures, proprietary trading risks, and unproven models.

Gate 2: Essential Western Need & Entrenched Everyday Habits

Essential survival necessities or entrenched everyday rituals ('likely to' spend) in Western rule-of-law jurisdictions. Rejects big-ticket deferrable cyclicals, pariah regimes, and predatory harm.

Gate 3: Strong Moat & Pricing Power >= Inflation

Requires a proven economic moat archetype (Toll booth, Scale economies, Infrastructure, R&D super-thinkers) PLUS empirical proof of moat: 5Y median ROIC ≥ 12% and incremental ROIIC ≥ 12%.

Gate 4: Low Disruption Risk & Predictable Runway (CAP ≥ 15 Years)

Two-step longevity engine: Outside View anchors baseline CAP in Mauboussin & Callahan empirical persistence tiers (10–30Y). Inside View deductively haircuts CAP for 5 Macrotrends (AI cognitive disruption, demographic aging, supply chain reshoring, energy limits, structural inflation).

Gate 5: Honest, Able, Customer-Focused Management & Capital Allocation

Scored 0–2 across 5 vectors: skin in the game, rational capital allocation, customer centricity, plain talk, and low principal-agent friction.

Gate 6: Real Cash Conversion, Peak-to-Peak Compounding & Fortress Balance Sheet

Triad: (1) Secular Peak-to-Peak Owner EPS compounding across cycles, (2) Real cash conversion (multi-year FCF ≥ 80% GAAP NI), (3) Peace-of-mind fortress balance sheet (Net Debt ≤ 4y Owner Earnings, Interest Coverage > 5x).

Conditional Calamity Pass (Buffett Temporary Fixable Calamities — Gates 3b, 5, 6 Only)

Great franchises with an intact moat and runway occasionally breach Gate 3b (trailing ROIC/pricing dip), Gate 5 (outgoing/remediating management), or Gate 6 (temporary M&A bridge debt or capex surge). Flagging calamity = Y preserves raw failed scores, evaluates all remaining gates, and admits them into Quantitative PAR valuation under a separate Calamity pass tier. Gates 1, 2, 3a (moat != None), and 4 (CAP ≥ 15Y) are never waivable.

Quantitative Valuation: Equity Bond Below PAR

Fundamental PAR Multiple Formula (v6.30):

PAR Multiple = min(mult_high_5y, (M_eff * g_exp + min(5Y_Midpoint_Mult, 35.0) + min(Operating_ROIC * 100, 35.0)) / 3)
M_eff = M_cap * η_reinv | M_cap: 240 (CAP ≥ 30y), 200 (CAP ≥ 20y), 170 (CAP ≥ 15y) | η_reinv = clamp((1 - g/ROIC) / (1 - g/0.35), 0.25, 1.0)

Active Earning Power (50/50 Mid-Cycle Reversion Standard):

Active EPS = min(Peak_OE_EPS, 0.5 * (Peak_OE_EPS + max(0, Cur_TTM_EPS))) | Peak_eps_est overrides
When current earnings drop below peak, normalizes base earning power to mid-cycle to prevent cyclical bubble peaks from distorting PAR Value and 5Y IRR.

4-Filter Credible Growth Engine (v6.30):

g_raw = min(g_fund, g_demand)  |  Expected g (g_exp) = min(Rev_Scale_Cap, StepDown_Fade(g_raw), g_implied)
1. Capital Supply Ceiling (g_fund): (1 - 5Y_Div_Payout) * R_inc + Zero_Cap_Pricing + min(0, Buyback_Yield)  (Zero-Cap Tollbooth exemption for ≥35% Operating ROIC)
2. Objective Demand & Margin Ceiling (g_demand): min(12.0%, Verified_Sales_CAGR + Buyback_Yield + 0.5%)  (unfaded; disallows perpetual margin expansion)
3. Step-Down Fade toward 3.5% GDP: g_raw ≥ 3.5%: w * g_raw + (1 - w) * 3.5%  (w = 0.75 CAP ≥30y, 0.60 CAP ≥20y, 0.45 CAP ≥15y) | g_raw < 3.5%: max(2.0%, g_raw)
4. Revenue Size Gravity & Post-Fade Ceiling: Mega-Rev (≥ $50B) ≤ 8.5% | Large-Rev ($15B - $50B) ≤ 10.0% | Mid/Small-Rev (< $15B) ≤ 12.0% | bounded post-fade by g_implied
